messages:
Alex W: quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/52488 is a hotfix for a KV-eviction race. Need runtime + security eyes, aiming to merge during tonight's 23:30 UTC canary window. cc @Ben R @Maya K @Sam T
Priya S: can you drop the minimal diff and a one-liner on why this is safe for a hotfix?
Alex W: sure — minimal diff: ```diff
- if (cache.size() > limit) evict();
+ while (cache.size() > limit) evict();
```
Fixes a path where under concurrent batches only one evict was called. Unit + integ tests pass; e2e flaky but local passes. No schema/infra changes.
Ben R: I'll run a quick perf run on staging, give me ~40–50m. please add me as reviewer on the PR.
Maya K: quick sec question — does this touch any KMS/HSM or auth flows? if not I can do a lightweight review once Ben confirms perf.
Sam T: infra side: no rollout hooks needed unless you change config. I can toggle the canary flag at 23:30 and monitor.
Alex W: added Ben as reviewer, no KMS involved (pure eviction loop). Plan: merge -> enable canary flag `kv-fix-hotfix` -> monitor 30m -> full rollout.
Ben R: running perf now on staging with synthetic batch workload. will post numbers in ~20m.
deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window reserved for eng tonight at 2026-03-18T23:30:00Z (23:30 UTC).
Priya S: thanks — if Ben's numbers look ok I'm happy to greenlight from a product/UX perspective.
Ben R: results: staging run p50 +2%, p95 +3%, tail unchanged. memory stable. this looks within acceptable range. +1 from runtime.
Maya K: did a quick code skim — no crypto/KMS/auth touched. small nit on comment, but not blocking. +1 sec.
Sam T: ready to flip the canary flag at 23:30 and watch health dashboards. I'll do a manual rollback plan in case of issues.
Alex W: merging in 2m, will post follow-up with canary metrics. thanks all :pray:
